title: The Lost Crystals
description: Adventurer, the Hollow Caverns hold 3 Dream Crystals. Retrieve them to restore light to our village!
inProgressText: You’ve accepted the quest. Collect 3 Dream Crystals from the Hollow Caverns.
completedText: Incredible! You’ve collected the 3 Dream Crystals and saved our village!

title: The Forest Spirit
description: The Forest Spirit requests 2 Dream Crystals to renew its strength. Will you help?
inProgressText: Keep searching for 2 Dream Crystals to aid the Forest Spirit.
completedText: The Forest Spirit is restored, thanks to your 2 Dream Crystals!
